attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"has imposed tolls on the gorge road","reason":"Briefing says tolls were demanded, not imposed."},{"span":"threatens to choke the trade routes leading to the Iron Covenant outposts","reason":"Adds unsupported consequence for Covenant trade routes."},{"span":"Vex's Crew remains idle in their two settlements, merely waiting for an opportunity to strike","reason":"Briefing gives no information on Vex's Crew activity or intent."},{"span":"last week","reason":"Invented timing for the wagon loss."},{"span":"their complaints about the tolls have grown louder since then","reason":"No Covenant reaction to the tolls is in the briefing."},{"span":"carrying scrolls that contained no specific demands other than general respect for the Empire's authority","reason":"Invents scroll contents, which earlier bulletin said were unknown."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It breaks format by copying the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, and it invents several details, including the scroll contents and the Covenant's toll complaints. It has none of Ilse's dry, wry voice."}
